definitions.explanation: A white powder (sodium bicarbonate) used in cooking, cleaning, and various household applications. Also called sodium hydrogen carbonate.

examples.japanese: {重曹|じゅうそう}で{汚|よご}れを{落|お}とす。
お{菓子|かし}を{作|つく}るときに{重曹|じゅうそう}を{少|すこ}し{入|い}れる。
examples.english: Add a little baking soda when making sweets.

examples.japanese: {重曹|じゅうそう}は{料理|りょうり}だけでなく、{掃除|そうじ}や{消臭|しょうしゅう}にも{使|つか}える{万能|ばんのう}アイテムだ。
examples.english: Baking soda is a versatile item that can be used not only for cooking but also for cleaning and deodorizing.

notes:
The Japanese name literally means "double carbonate" ({重|じゅう} = double/layered + {曹|そう} = carbonate). A staple household product in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {重曹|じゅうそう}を{溶|と}かす (to dissolve baking soda)
- {重曹|じゅうそう}で{掃除|そうじ}する (to clean with baking soda)
- {重曹|じゅうそう}を{振|ふ}りかける (to sprinkle baking soda)

Popular in Japan as a natural cleaning agent. Often featured in household tips and life hack articles. In cooking, it is used as a leavening agent and to soften dried beans.
